name.value: Dutch Lake Motel and RV Campground

description.value: Commercial motel and RV campground in Clearwater, BC, situated on or near Dutch Lake and convenient to the Wells Gray Provincial Park corridor. Oriented toward RV travellers; tent options and touring-cyclist amenities are unconfirmed.

raw_osm.name: Dutch Lake Motel and RV Campground

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page confirms the business name, address (333 Roy Rd, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N2), phone (250) 674-3325, and lists the actual business website as http://www.dutchlakemotel.com/ — distinct from the OSM URL which points to the Facebook page itself. OSM tags confirm free WiFi (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no), but the Facebook content is too sparse to confirm any camping-specific amenities. The business appears active with photos posted as recently as August 2022.
concerns: OSM url field points to Facebook page; the actual business website per Facebook is http://www.dutchlakemotel.com/ — website field updated to use the business's own site, flagged as discrepancy.
OSM had no phone number; (250) 674-3325 sourced from Facebook page.
Facebook content is minimal — no amenity details could be confirmed. Recommend checking dutchlakemotel.com directly for fuller amenity data.
url_discovery_notes flag that dutchlake.com is a separate nearby resort; the Facebook page and listed address are consistent with this being Dutch Lake Motel specifically, not that resort.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operating campground and motel in Clearwater with confirmed address and phone via Facebook. Useful stopping point for cyclists on the North Thompson route near Wells Gray Provincial Park.
enrichment_extras.notes: Free WiFi confirmed by OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) but not corroborated by the sparse Facebook page content.
